shape.instructions: Which report shape best serves a team that must hand in a buildable app, given the challenge asks for at least three rotation strategies with evidence, gaps and risks per strategy?

criteria.b: seven sections, evidence and agronomy only, build annex deferred until the user supplies the app idea

budget.instructions: Where should the depth budget sit, given three of the user's four questions are about challenge anatomy, farmer needs and the spacedata companion site, and the fourth is UX?

criteria.b: concentrate on data inventory, farmer decision drivers and UX, and hold prior-art and policy sections to fewer, denser subsections
